name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Ordering system for food trucks
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from overload and keep serving when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order as ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it needs. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs preparing now, what comes next and what’s ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen ticket printer over Bluetooth or through the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, pre-orders pause, so nobody places an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync when the connection returns.

BUILT FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get notified when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
